module_init_OOM_feasibility.detail: PyModule_AddObject is not reachable from Python. A real injection needs a compiled fault macro, a malloc interposer, or a static argument. This commission confines writes to the ownership defect, so a second fault macro was deliberately NOT added rather than silently widening the reviewed surface. Recorded as an explicit open item, consistent with HQ246-OPEN-003.

bounded_work_statement: This stage modified exactly one quarantined C file (_p07_native_owner_stage_b.c). _p07_native_owner_stage_a.c was inspected for the same ownership pattern and is NOT changed: its single PyList_AsTuple call site already performs the correct Py_DECREF, so the demonstrable-same-bug condition set by the commission is not met.
